ops.title: ccx payload lowering landed: generic MCP tool-spec registry
ops.body: Landed 2026-07-20. cc-transcript 14.4.0 ships a Rust-core runtime registry (register_mcp_tool/unregister_mcp_tool; McpToolSpec{behaves_like, span_edit payload-key map}; process-local, keyed by bare MCP segment) replacing the hardcoded MCP_TOOL_ALIASES const; registered span-edit specs lower to the SpanEditCall native view (file_path, new; None=delete; no pre-image). The ccx binding is declarative data: the cc-context ccx pack manifest's top-level [tools] table (pack 0.9.0, plugin 0.28.3). capt-hook 10.5.0 parses [tools] and registers during CliState.discover() (diff-reconcile; daemon snapshot hits re-reconcile), adds SpanEditCall arms to content/replaced/pre_image, and the comments touched() span fallback — so the verbose-comment hook fires on ccx edits, verified live on cold and hookd paths. capt-hook pins cc-transcript>=14.4,<14.5 until the 14.5 async persistence inversion is absorbed (tracked in capt-hook's backlog).
